summary: 太祖长孙，太宗崩后继立，天禄年间南伐后汉，被察割所弑，在位五年。
summary_en: Eldest grandson of Taizu, he succeeded after Taizong's death, campaigned south against Later Han during the Tianlu years, and was assassinated by Chage in 951 after five years on the throne.

bio_md:
# 辽世宗耶律阮 · 主要事迹

耶律阮（918—951），[[liao-tai-zu|太祖]]长孙，[[liao-tai-zong|太宗]]之侄。大同元年（947）太宗崩于栾城，阮在军中被立为帝，述律太后欲立其子李胡，祖孙兵争几起，终以太后让步告结。

世宗在位五年（947—951），改元天禄。他倾向汉化，重用汉臣，又屡兴南伐：天禄年间亲征后汉，掠河北州县，与中原战事不断。天禄五年（951）在祭父途中为宗室察割所弑，年三十四。其遇弑之速、享国之短，实为辽室内争之缩影。

died at Luancheng in 947. Empress Shulü wished her own son Lihu to reign; the court nearly came to arms before she yielded.

Shizong reigned five years (947-951), era Tianlu. He favored Sinicization and Han ministers, and repeatedly campaigned south against Later Han, plundering Hebei. In 951 he was assassinated by the clansman Chage on the way to a sacrifice for his father, at thirty-four - a short reign that mirrored the Liao court's inner strife.
